messages:
maria: FYI cutting the sample-app SDK but typegen produced a different TS overload order. Repro: `yarn && yarn typegen && git diff`
ben: Oof. paste the diff?
maria: small but affects positional callers:
```diff
- fetch(items: string[], opts?: {timeout?: number, retry?: boolean})
+ fetch(items: string[], retry?: boolean, opts?: {timeout?: number})
```
cassandra: That looks like a breaking change for TS. Our changelog bot only saw a comment update and labeled it patch. :grimacing: 
diego: Did openapi.yaml change? If not, must be a typegen param grouping change introduced in the last release. Which version?
maria: `@redwood/typegen` v0.12.3 (released last week). OpenAPI is identical. The generator seems to have a new heuristic for optional param flattening.
regen-bot: Created PR #4128 by maria - "typegen: preserve original param ordering to avoid positional break" (CI pending)
ben: Sample-app CI smoke is red because consumers expect old signature. We should block the release until resolved.
cassandra: Options: revert SDK publish and hold, patch typegen to restore ordering (0.12.4), or accept minor bump if new ordering is intentional. We also need changelog-bot to flag signature diffs as manual review.
diego: I'll try a minimal change to prefer existing tuple ordering when both optional groupings present. If safe, publish 0.12.4.
maria: I'm opening a revert PR for sample-app artifacts and marking the changelog entry as manual review. https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/219
ben: Add a deterministic test in typegen CI asserting overload ordering for optional params. This non-determinism keeps recurring.
diego: Adding the test and a changelog note explaining the heuristic. Also put a small reproducer gist: https://gist.github.com/diego/abcdef
cassandra: Holding the release until 0.12.4 is out and changelog corrected. Thanks all.
maria: Followups: 1) deterministic ordering test in CI, 2) changelog-bot mapping update, 3) postmortem if revert merges.
ben: Ping me if regen diffs flake again.
maria: Will confirm once 0.12.4 published and smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:
